36:           return if ignored_node?(node)

38:           return unless dig?(node)

50:         # Walk up the method chain while the receiver is `dig` with arguments.
51:         def inspect_chain(node)
52:           arguments = node.arguments.dup
53:           end_pos = node.source_range.end_pos
54: 
55:           while dig?((node = node.receiver))
56:             begin_pos = node.loc.dot ? node.loc.dot.begin_pos + 1 : 0
57:             arguments.unshift(*node.arguments)
58:             ignore_node(node)
59:           end
60: 
61:           return unless begin_pos

63:           [range_between(begin_pos, end_pos), arguments]
64:         end

67:           # If any of the arguments are arguments forwarding (`...`), it can only be the

72:           forwarded_args_index = arguments.index(&:forwarded_args_type?)

      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz)
      #

          return if invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          return unless range

          register_offense(node, range, arguments)

        # Walk up the method chain while the receiver is `dig` with arguments.
        def inspect_chain(node)
          arguments = node.arguments.dup

          while dig?((node = node.receiver))
            begin_pos = node.loc.dot ? node.loc.dot.begin_pos + 1 : 0
            arguments.unshift(*node.arguments)
            ignore_node(node)
          end

          return unless begin_pos

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `inspect_chain` (lib/rubocop/cop/style/dig_chain.rb:56): the autocorrect range started at `dot.begin_pos + 1`, assuming a one-character `.` separator. For safe navigation (`&.`) and `::` dispatch the separator is two characters, so the replacement range began one character too early, leaving a stray `&` that later got mangled into `hoge & dig(...)`. Using `node.loc.dot.end_pos` handles `.` (regular call), `&.` (safe navigation), and `::` uniformly.

- `spec/rubocop/cop/style/dig_chain_spec.rb`: 23/23 pass (including the safe-navigation chain case)
- `spec/rubocop/cop/style/single_argument_dig_spec.rb`: 15/15 pass
- Issue reproduction: `hoge&.dig(:a)&.dig(:b)` now corrects to `hoge&.dig(:a, :b)`
